# BE11 Full Knowledge Base & Production Facts Reference

## 1. Organization & Core Identity
BE11 (https://be11.in) is India's sports ground reservation and athletic match management platform, headquartered in Faridabad, Haryana, India. It serves sports enthusiasts, teams, and tournament organizers across Haryana and the Delhi NCR region.

Key positioning:
- Sports ground and pitch reservations (Cricket, Football)
- Live Match lobby system for individual players and teams
- 3D Interactive Team Jersey Builder (sublimated custom kits)
- Modular Cricket Kit Builder (equipment bundles)
- Verified sports coaches directory
- Sports equipment retail store
- BE11 Capture automated HD match recording
- BE11 Toss 3D coin flip simulator
- Tournament hosting and fixture coordination
- Vendor and sports ground partner onboarding

Official Contacts:
- WhatsApp Support: +91 87001 90843 (https://wa.me/918700190843)
- Email Support: support@be11.in
- Working Hours: 24x7 Customer Support Assistance

## 3. Services & Features

### Live Matches (/live-matches)
- Open Match Lobbies allow individual players to join competitive matches without assembling two 11-player squads.
- Standard lobby has 22 player slots (11 per team).
- Transparent real-time slot counter connected to database.
- Entry fee per slot (e.g. ₹299 per player).

### 3D Custom Jersey Builder (/jersey-builder)
- Real-time 3D web preview with 360-degree rotation.
- Customizable base patterns, colors, collar styles, sleeves, player names, squad numbers, and sponsor logos.
- Full squad roster ordering with individual player sizing (S to XXL).
- Sublimated printing on moisture-wicking breathable sports polyester fabric.

### Cricket Kit Builder (/kit-builder)
- Modular bundle configurator for cricket gear.
- Presets: Beginner, Intermediate, and Pro.
- Authentic equipment from verified sports manufacturers.

### Certified Coaches Directory (/coaches)
- Verified profiles of bowling specialists, batting coaches, and fitness trainers in Faridabad.
- Direct booking for 1-on-1 coaching sessions and academy camps.

### Sports Retail Store (/store)
- Direct delivery of English/Kashmir willow bats, match leather balls, batting pads, gloves, helmets, footballs, and athletic accessories across India.
- Prices in INR (₹) with secure online checkout.

### BE11 Capture (/capture)
- Multi-angle HD match video recording service for cricket and football fixtures.
- Automated highlight reels (boundaries, wickets, key moments).

### BE11 Toss (/toss)
- Free 3D physics-based coin toss simulator for team captains.

### Tournament Hosting (/tournaments)
- Tournament portal for leagues, corporate tournaments, and youth cups.
- Ground scheduling, umpire assignment, and team registration management.

### Become a Vendor (/become-vendor)
- Ground owner, sports merchant, and coach onboarding portal.

---

## 4. Ground Booking Workflow
1. Select venue from https://be11.in/venues.
2. Select match date on the interactive calendar.
3. Choose match period or package.
4. Select booking type (Entire Venue, Half Team, or Individual).
5. Enter contact info (Name, 10-digit Indian Mobile, Email).
6. Complete payment via BE11 Wallet or Razorpay.
7. Booking is confirmed instantly and visible under /my-bookings.

---

## 5. Policies
- Cancellation: Bookings cancelled 4+ hours before slot time receive 100% refund in BE11 Wallet.
- Weather: Matches disrupted by rain or wet ground conditions are rescheduled with the ground administrator.
- Security: User passwords encrypted with Bcrypt. Secure JWT authentication. No personal data sold to third parties.
